summary: EMAIL-CONSOLIDATE complete: Flerken is canonical email agent; email-summary-agent and personal-automation archived; offline digest ported.
details:
## Audit (Tasks 1–3)
| Source | Unique capabilities | Ported? |
|--------|---------------------|--------|
| email-summary-agent | MSAL Graph fetch + gpt-4o-mini markdown brief | No — Flerken already superset (triage, HTML, dashboard, severity) |
| personal-automation | Apple Mail export parser, regex High/Med/Low, suggested actions | Yes → `src/optional/offline_mail_digest.py` |
| delivery-workbench | Multi-step YAML, human_gate on draft/organize, morning job excludes writes | Reference only → `docs/orchestration_reference/*.yaml` |

## Task 4 — Ports
- `agents/flerken/src/optional/offline_mail_digest.py` + CLI `python run.py --offline-mail [export.txt]`
- Orchestration YAML copies + README (patterns, not executable in Flerken yet)

## Task 5 — Archive
- `_archived/email-summary-agent/` (from agents/)
- `_archived/personal-automation/` (from tools/)
- delivery-workbench left intact

## Task 6–8
- Flerken README: Consolidated From + offline mode
- MASTER_INDEX: #7 ACTIVE canonical, #8–9 ARCHIVE
- Security: grep clean on source; .env not git-tracked; .gitignore hardened (token*, *.pem)

## Ambiguous
- delivery-workbench specialist markdown agents remain in workbench (orchestration layer, not merged into Flerken code)
